Application Data.NAME: Smith's Camera & Photo Supply
Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Smith's Camera & Photo Supply specializes in providing a wide range of camera and photography equipment, including digital cameras, lenses, tripods, and photo accessories. Our store caters to both amateur and professional photographers, offering personalized customer service and expert advice to help clients select the right products for their needs. Additionally, we operate a small in-house photography studio for portrait and event photography, utilizing standard studio equipment. We do not engage in any drone operations or chemical processing, ensuring a safe and compliant environment for our customers and staff. Our inventory is valued well below $500,000, and we maintain rigorous security measures to protect our assets.
